# Vivek Suyambu

> Vivek Suyambu (keviveks) is a software engineer and engineering lead at Brainfish, based in Bengaluru.

Vivek Suyambu and keviveks are the same person. keviveks is his online handle, used on this site and on GitHub, LinkedIn, X, WordPress, and CodePen. He is a Senior Software Engineer at Brainfish in Bengaluru, where he has worked since 2023, building AI-powered capabilities, scalable systems, and connections between AI and real-world business workflows. He is also a core engineering team member on Ballet, an AI playbook and workflow orchestration platform.
